name: Kuronagi Soushi
source:
He is a graduate student and the eldest brother of Mikoto. He has a kind personality and is a good brother who gently watches over his younger sister, Mikoto, and his younger brother, Wakazumi. 
He is not good at housework despite living alone away from home.
